# Agency Refund Policy

This policy describes how the Agency Service Bureau handles refund requests.

## Eligibility

A customer may request a refund within 30 days of the payment date. Requests made after 30 days are declined unless the payment was made in error by the Bureau.

## Processing

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days. Refunds above 500 dollars require a second approver.

## Exceptions

Fees for expedited handling are non-refundable. Customers may appeal a declined request to the Review Panel within 14 days.
